content: In WAL mode a SQLite .db file alone is NOT a complete backup: recent committed transactions may live in the -wal file (oneuptime.com, sqlite.org forum). Safe options: the .backup command / online backup API, VACUUM INTO for a single-file snapshot, or PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) before a manual copy. Backup before running schema migrations to keep a restore point; user_version pragma or equivalent tracks migration state. WAL requires db and wal on same machine (sqlite.org).
